## About

Rakesh designs enterprise solutions with distributed development teams around the world. The work centers on legacy code transformation, DevSecOps transitions across on-prem and cloud environments, and AI-assisted developer tooling.

## What I'm working on

- **Enterprise solution design:** architecting systems with globally distributed dev teams.
- **Legacy modernization:** transforming aging codebases into maintainable, cloud-ready platforms.
- **DevSecOps transitions:** building secure CI/CD pipelines across on-prem and cloud environments.
- **AI-assisted coding:** evaluating and integrating AI tooling into enterprise developer workflows.
- Researching AI and math on the side.

## Projects

Page: https://rakeshkrishnan.com/projects/

### Repo Cleanup Automation
Category: DevSecOps, automation.
A GitHub Actions workflow, triggered manually, that lists the account's repositories through the GitHub REST API, filters for those with no updates in 3+ months using PowerShell, and processes them to keep the account tidy. Source: https://github.com/GH-user-001/GH-user-001/blob/main/.github/workflows/cleanup.yml

### This website
A static multi-page site (plain HTML and CSS, no build step) deployed to GitHub Pages by a GitHub Actions workflow on every push to main, with CodeQL scanning of the workflows. Source: https://github.com/GH-user-001/GH-user-001

## Concepts & diagrams

Page: https://rakeshkrishnan.com/concepts/ . A growing set of plain-language explanations, each with an editable draw.io diagram.

- **HTTP Request Lifecycle** (https://rakeshkrishnan.com/concepts/http-request-lifecycle/): how a browser turns a URL into a rendered page: DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP, and rendering. Covers the mental model, how it works, trade-offs and common mistakes, and sources.
- **What is Object-Oriented Programming?** (https://rakeshkrishnan.com/concepts/what-is-oop/): classes, objects, properties, methods, and the four pillars: encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism.
